jobs.title: IT Architect
jobs.description:
Voor de één zit het in grote namen en indrukwekkende organisaties. Voor de ander juist in wat je daadwerkelijk verandert. Want laten we eerlijk zijn: hoe groter het bedrijf, hoe kleiner vaak jouw stukje van de puzzel. Jij zoekt liever een omgeving waar jouw keuzes ertoe doen. Waar wat jij vandaag bedenkt, morgen zichtbaar is in de praktijk.

Je klapt je laptop open en scrolt door LinkedIn. Tussen de bekende namen en standaard vacatures blijft je oog hangen op iets anders. Een rol bij Kruitbosch. Geen logge corporate, maar ook geen kleine club die het “erbij doet”. Dit is een organisatie die groot genoeg is om het professioneel in te richten en klein genoeg om het verschil te kunnen maken. Je leest verder. Over een landschap dat in beweging is. Over systemen die slimmer, schaalbaarder en toekomstbestendiger worden ingericht. Maar vooral lees je tussen de regels iets anders: hier bouw je niet aan een klein onderdeel, hier beïnvloed je het geheel. Je merkt dat het begint te kriebelen. Dit is geen omgeving waar je verdwijnt in de massa. Hier ligt verantwoordelijkheid lager in de organisatie. Dat betekent: meedenken, richting geven en keuzes maken die er écht toe doen.

Dit is precies waar jij energie van krijgt. Impact maken. Zichtbaar en concreet, binnen een organisatie die het serieus genoeg neemt om het ook écht goed neer te zetten.

Wie zijn wij?

Wij zijn Kruitbosch. Het bedrijf achter merken als Cortina en Alpina en de groothandel PENDLR. Wat ooit begon als lokale speler in Zwolle, is in ruim 70 jaar uitgegroeid tot een toonaangevende organisatie in duurzame fietsmobiliteit in Nederland en België.

De organisatie bestaat uit twee duidelijke pijlers:
PENDLR: levert producten, concepten en maatwerkoplossingen aan zo’n 3.500 fietsdealers.
Cortina: ontwikkelt en levert fietsen en e-bikes voor de Europese markt.

Samen met zo’n 250 collega’s in Zwolle en Lier bouwen we dagelijks aan de toekomst van mobiliteit. Als familiebedrijf zijn de lijnen kort, kennen mensen elkaar en worden beslissingen dicht bij de praktijk genomen. Binnen deze context speelt IT een steeds belangrijkere rol.

De afdeling Digital bestaat uit drie domeinen: IT Operations, IT Development en Business Support. Hier wordt gewerkt aan alles wat nodig is om de organisatie digitaal te laten draaien én te laten groeien. Van infrastructuur en security tot development, integraties en businessapplicaties.

Als IT Architect bevind je je precies in het midden van dit speelveld. Je werkt over de domeinen heen en zorgt dat alles, van infrastructuur tot applicaties, logisch met elkaar verbonden blijft. Je schakelt met developers, product owners en operations, en hebt daarmee zicht op het volledige landschap. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Support Unit Leader Digital, waardoor je dicht op de besluitvorming zit en snel kunt schakelen. Dat maakt deze rol anders dan bij veel andere organisaties: je zit niet in een silo, maar op het snijvlak van alles wat ertoe doet.

Wat houdt de functie in?

In deze rol draait het niet om het aansturen van mensen, maar om het bepalen van richting. Jij houdt overzicht in een steeds complexer IT-landschap en zorgt dat alles logisch, schaalbaar en toekomstbestendig blijft. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van business en technologie. Je vertaalt wensen naar concrete architectuurkeuzes en bewaakt de samenhang, niet alleen op hoofdlijnen, maar juist in de details waar het verschil wordt gemaakt.

Je werkt nauw samen met developers, product owners en andere stakeholders. Jij stelt de kaders waarbinnen zij bouwen. Dat betekent: keuzes maken over bouwen of kopen, bepalen hoe systemen met elkaar communiceren en zorgen dat het geheel blijft kloppen. Je kijkt daarbij altijd naar het grotere geheel. Van datastromen tot integraties en van legacy naar vernieuwing. Jouw keuzes hebben directe invloed op hoe de organisatie werkt en groeit.

Waarom ga je dit doen?

De afgelopen periode is er binnen Kruitbosch stevig geïnvesteerd in het moderniseren van het IT-landschap. Dat gaat verder dan alleen techniek. Het raakt processen, samenwerking en de manier waarop keuzes worden gemaakt. Daar kom jij in beeld.

Als IT Architect speel je een sleutelrol in deze ontwikkeling. Jij creëert overzicht en zorgt dat keuzes niet alleen technisch kloppen, maar ook passen binnen het geheel.

De uitdaging zit in samenhang. Systemen moeten slimmer met elkaar communiceren, keuzes moeten toekomstbestendig zijn en teams moeten begrijpen waarom iets op een bepaalde manier wordt ingericht. Jij zorgt voor die vertaalslag.

Je stelt de juiste vragen om tot de kern te komen. Waar zit de bottleneck? Wat moet anders? En hoe zorgen we dat oplossingen ook daadwerkelijk werken in de praktijk? Je denkt in mogelijkheden. Je ziet kansen om te standaardiseren, te vereenvoudigen en te vernieuwen en durft daar richting in te geven. Het resultaat zie je direct terug in hoe systemen presteren en hoe de organisatie ermee werkt.

Wat doe je zoal tijdens een werkdag?

Je start je dag met een korte daily stand-up. Waar zitten knelpunten? En waar moet jij vandaag richting geven? Er wordt gewerkt volgens agile principes, wat betekent dat je regelmatig schakelt met product owners en developers, bijvoorbeeld tijdens refinements of sprintmomenten. Je kijkt naar performance, stabiliteit en afhankelijkheden. Waar zitten afwijkingen en wat betekent dat voor het grotere geheel?

Later op de ochtend duik je inhoudelijk de diepte in. Samen met specialisten bespreek je een verandering in het landschap. Bijvoorbeeld een nieuwe koppeling of een aanpassing in de architectuur. Jij bewaakt de lijn: past dit binnen de architectuur?

Na de pauze sluit je aan bij een audit of review, bijvoorbeeld op security of architectuurprincipes. Jij bent het aanspreekpunt als het gaat om de inrichting van het landschap.

Aan het einde van de dag kijk je vooruit. Nieuwe initiatieven, wijzigingen en impact op bestaande structuren. Je zorgt dat keuzes vandaag geen problemen worden voor morgen. De rode draad: jij houdt overzicht en zorgt dat alles logisch op elkaar blijft aansluiten.

De functie-eisen:

HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in een IT-gerelateerde richting.
Enkele jaren ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol (bijv. IT Architect, Solution Architect of senior developer met architectuurverantwoordelijkheid).
Brede kennis van IT-landschappen, integraties en architectuurprincipes.
Ervaring met moderne technologieën zoals cloud (bijv. Azure), .NET, Java en databases.
Inzicht in hoe systemen, processen en business met elkaar samenhangen.

Deze eigenschappen passen bij jou:

Je bent analytisch sterk en weet complexe vraagstukken snel te doorgronden en te structureren.
Je communiceert makkelijk op verschillende niveaus en weet techniek en business te verbinden.
Je bent proactief en signaleert waar het beter kan, nog voordat het een probleem wordt.
Je denkt in oplossingen — pragmatisch waar nodig, vernieuwend waar het kan.
Je overtuigt door inhoud en zorgt dat ideeën ook daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd.

Herken jij jezelf in de bovenstaande functie-eisen en eigenschappen? Dan ben jij misschien wel de IT Architect die wij bij Kruitbosch nodig hebben!

Wat krijg je van ons?

Een salaris van € 4.664,17 tot € 6.556,48 bruto per maand (afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring) op basis van een fulltime dienstverband.
Een uitstekende pensioenregeling die volledig door Kruitbosch wordt betaald.
Een contract voor bepaalde tijd, met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband bij wederzijdse tevredenheid.
Een uitdagende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week.
Flexibele werktijden en hybride werken met thuiswerkvergoeding.
26 verlofdagen bij een fulltime dienstverband. Wil je meer vrije dagen? Dan kun je maximaal 5 dagen bijkopen.
Een winstdelingsregeling.
Goede regeling voor het aanschaffen van een fiets en fietsaccessoires.
Ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden via de School of Kruitbosch.
Een actieve personeelsvereniging die leuke uitjes organiseert.

Zomaar een aantal redenen om bij ons te willen werken

Je werkt in een organisatie die groot genoeg is om het professioneel neer te zetten, maar klein genoeg om echt verschil te maken.
Je hebt directe impact op het volledige IT-landschap.
Je komt terecht in een omgeving die volop in beweging is.
Je werkt dicht op de business en ziet direct resultaat van je werk.
Een logische volgende stap als je meer invloed wilt op het grotere geheel.
Je krijgt de ruimte om richting te geven aan architectuur en keuzes.

Enthousiast?

Zie jij jezelf al werken bij één van de bekendste fietsmerken van Nederland? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

jobs.description:
About The Company

RiskConsult GmbH is a leading provider of risk management solutions with a global footprint. Our innovative software is utilized worldwide for managing risks associated with large-scale projects across various industries. We serve both our own consulting division and a diverse client base, delivering tools that enhance decision-making and project safety. Our commitment to technological excellence and continuous improvement positions us at the forefront of risk management technology. Located in Innsbruck, Austria, RiskConsult GmbH fosters a collaborative and dynamic work environment dedicated to developing high-quality software solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers.

About The Role

We are seeking a skilled .NET / WPF Software Developer to join our development team in Innsbruck. In this role, you will be instrumental in advancing our desktop application, a sophisticated WPF-based solution built on the .NET framework. Your primary focus will be on enhancing the application's functionality, refactoring legacy code, and ensuring the robustness of our software through testing and documentation. As part of our team, you will work closely with project managers, partners, and clients to deliver high-quality features that meet user needs. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a motivated developer to contribute to impactful projects in a collaborative environment, with room for professional growth as your product knowledge deepens.

Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have a genuine passion for programming and a strong foundation in software development. You should enjoy crafting clear, maintainable code and understand that elegant solutions often require multiple iterations. Open communication and teamwork are essential, as collaboration is a core part of our development process. Candidates should possess a completed education or degree, preferably with a technical or analytical focus such as Computer Science, HTL, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field. You should have either several years of professional experience with C# and .NET, ideally with WPF, or demonstrable programming experience from personal projects or other technical environments. Fluency in German (spoken and written, C1/C2 level) is required, as all technical documentation and communication are conducted in German. Proficiency in English is advantageous.

Responsibilities

Your key responsibilities will include the ongoing development and enhancement of our WPF desktop application using C# and .NET, covering everything from data models and backend logic to user interface design with XAML and MVVM architecture. You will refactor existing legacy code to improve performance and maintainability, and implement unit and integration tests to ensure software quality. Developing auxiliary tools to support the main application and creating comprehensive technical documentation and user help materials will also be part of your duties. As your familiarity with the product grows, you will provide support and engage directly with partners and customers, addressing their needs and incorporating feedback into future development cycles. Your work will contribute significantly to the stability, usability, and evolution of our risk management software.

Benefits

At RiskConsult GmbH, we prioritize your professional development and work-life balance. You will receive a structured onboarding process directly involving the codebase, allowing you to quickly become familiar with our product. As your product knowledge increases, your scope for influence and responsibility will expand. We promote a culture of open dialogue, where solutions and architectural decisions are made collaboratively, and you will have the autonomy to implement your ideas. Regular feedback from project managers and clients ensures that your work has a tangible impact, and you can see your code in action. Our flexible work arrangements include a Gleitzeit model, with the possibility of home office based on mutual agreement. Modern, centrally located offices are available in Innsbruck, providing a comfortable and inspiring work environment. The position offers a competitive salary starting at EUR 4,000 gross per month, based on 14 salaries, with additional compensation for relevant experience.

Equal Opportunity

RiskConsult GmbH is committed to fostering an inclusive environment and equal opportunity employment. We value diversity and are dedicated to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and excellence, and we are committed to supporting a culture of respect and fairness for all employees.

Die GRÜN Software Group entwickelt seit Jahrzehnten Unternehmens-Branchensoftware für Institutionen sowie Unternehmen aus den Bereichen Handel, Medien und Industrie. Nach der Leitlinie „Branchen brauchen Spezialisten“ entstehen unsere Lösungen in spezialisierten Tochtergesellschaften, jeweils fokussiert auf eine klar definierte Branche oder Teilbranche. So entwickeln wir hochfunktionale Software für geschäftskritische Prozesse mit langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen. Das Portfolio der GRÜN Software Group gliedert sich in vier Plattformen für die genannten Zielgruppen: Institutionen, Medien, Handel und Industrie.
Für unser Headquarter in Aachen mit rund 150 Mitarbeitenden suchen wir Dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als AI Software Engineering Architect (m/w/d) für ERP-Software-Produkte für verschiedene Branchen
. 
Du gestaltest eine neue Form der Softwareentwicklung in unserer Unternehmensgruppe: nicht als klassischer Entwickler im alten Modell, sondern als jemand, der Softwareentwicklung mit KI-gestützten Arbeitsweisen selbst operativ durchführt und daraus neue Standards und Vorgehensweisen aufbaut.
In dieser Rolle gehst Du selbst in bestehende Anwendungen und Codebasen hinein, analysierst technische und fachliche Anforderungen, setzt Wartungs- und Weiterentwicklungsaufgaben mit Hilfe moderner KI-Werkzeuge um und schaffst aus der Praxis heraus die Grundlage für ein neues Team und neue Arbeitsweisen.
Du gehst voran, krempelst die Ärmel hoch und zeigst an realen Systemen, wie KI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung im Unternehmensalltag funktioniert.

Das erwartet Dich bei uns:

Du arbeitest Dich eigenständig in bestehende Anwendungen, Codebasen und Tech-Stacks ein.
Du setzt Wartungs-, Verbesserungs- und Weiterentwicklungsaufgaben selbst operativ mit KI-gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen um.
Du strukturierst fachliche und technische Anforderungen so, dass daraus klare, umsetzbare Arbeitsaufträge entstehen.
Du definierst aus der praktischen Arbeit heraus Standards für Repo-Instruktionen, kleine KI-gestützte Changes, Review, Quality Gates und wiederverwendbare Vorgehensweisen.
Du bewertest Tools, IDEs und agentische Entwicklungsansätze auf ihren konkreten Nutzen im Alltag.
Du arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklung und Management zusammen.
Du schaffst die Grundlage für ein neues Team und eine skalierbare Form der KI-gestützten Softwareentwicklung in unserer Gruppe.

Das bringst Du mit:

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung, Softwarearchitektur oder technischen Projektverantwortung.
Sehr gutes Verständnis für gewachsene Softwaresysteme und unterschiedliche Tech-Stacks, z. B. C#, PHP oder Java.
Du kennst moderne KI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge, z. B. agentische Coding Workflows, aktuelle IDEs und den produktiven Einsatz großer Sprachmodelle im Softwarekontext.
Die Fähigkeit, Dich schnell in bestehende Codebasen einzuarbeiten und technische Zusammenhänge sicher zu erfassen.
Erfahrung in der praktischen Umsetzung technischer Anforderungen, idealerweise auch in Wartung und Weiterentwicklung von Bestandssoftware.
Die Fähigkeit, selbst operativ voranzugehen und gleichzeitig aus der Praxis Standards für andere abzuleiten.
Eine strukturierte, analytische und pragmatische Arbeitsweise.
Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse.

Das wäre zusätzlich hilfreich:

Erfahrung mit Legacy-Systemen und heterogenen Anwendungslandschaften.
Erfahrung mit Build-, Test- und Review-Prozessen.
Erfahrung in der Einführung technischer Standards und neuer Arbeitsweisen.

Bei uns stehst Du im Mittelpunkt - Das bieten wir Dir:

Wir wissen, dass großartige Arbeit nur in einem inspirierenden Umfeld entstehen kann. Deshalb bieten wir Dir mehr als „nur“ einen Arbeitsplatz. Wir bieten Dir nicht nur eine gute Verkehrsanbindung, kostenfreie Parkplätze, tägliches frisches Obst und so viel Wasser, Kaffee und Tee, wie Du trinken kannst. Für uns stehst Du im Mittelpunkt und das wollen wir Dir auch zeigen:
Gestaltungsspielraum & Verantwortung:
Dich erwartet eine Schlüsselrolle mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und sichtbarer Wirkung im Unternehmen.
Aufbau neuer Themenfelder:
Du hast die Möglichkeit, neue Themen praktisch und operativ mitzugestalten und nachhaltig zu etablieren.
Eigenverantwortung & schnelle Entscheidungen:
Kurze Entscheidungswege ermöglichen Dir eigenständiges Arbeiten und schnelle Umsetzung Deiner Ideen.
Starkes Team:
Dich erwartet ein kollegiales Umfeld innerhalb einer wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe, in dem Zusammenarbeit großgeschrieben wird.
Work-Life-Balance:
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeiten geben Dir mehr Flexibilität zur Vereinbarkeit Deines Arbeits- und Privatlebens.
Weiterentwicklung:
Wir legen großen Wert auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit und sind stolz auf unsere niedrige Mitarbeiterfluktuation. Deshalb bieten wir Dir individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und gute Aufstiegschancen.
Gesundheit & Fitness:
Ob Virtual Reality Fitness, gemeinsame Betriebssportaktivitäten oder Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft - Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen, deshalb unterstützen wir Dich in Deinen Fitnessbemühungen.
Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf:
Wir sind als "Familienfreundliches Unternehmen" ausgezeichnet durch das Kompetenzzentrum Frau und Beruf der Region Aachen.
Nachhaltigkeit & Umwelt:
Bei uns ist der Name auch Programm. Wir entlasten die Umwelt nicht nur durch Digitalisierung, sondern betreiben auch GRÜNe IT: von Jobbike über Ladestationen für Elektroautos bis hin zum Betrieb unseres Rechenzentrums mit Sonnenenergie. Darüber hinaus bieten wir ein Jobticket für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr an und betreiben sogar einen eigenen Bienenstock auf dem Dach unseres Firmengebäudes, um zur Artenvielfalt beizutragen.
Zusatzleistungen & Corporate Benefits:
Bonusprogramm, betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen und exklusive Mitarbeiterangebote runden unser Angebot ab.

Als Experte für das Data Engineering bist Du im Projekt Ansprechpartner für Kollegen und Kunden. Mit modernen cloud-basierten Technologien generierst Du - KI-unterstützt - innovative Lösungen rund um unsere Produkte.

für unsere Standorte in Karlsruhe, Stuttgart, Hamburg,
München oder Köln.

Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB und Datalake Storage
Weitere Komponenten aus dem Azure Stack wie Log Analytics, KeyVault, API Management
Azure Portal

Interesse an konzeptionellen Themen rund um Datenmodellierung und ETL-Design
Bereitschaft zur Weiterentwicklung in Technologien wie Databricks und Data Factory

In der DYMATRIX-Gruppe entwickeln wir mit Leidenschaft innovative Softwarelösungen für datengetriebene, KI-gestützte Customer Experiences. Unsere SaaS-Plattform ermöglicht es Unternehmen, ihre Kontakte automatisiert und personalisiert über alle Kanäle hinweg anzusprechen. Doch wir liefern nicht nur die Technologie – unsere Expert:innen begleiten Kunden von Strategie und Implementierung bis hin zum laufenden Betrieb. Damit das gelingt, brauchen wir ein starkes Team – wir brauchen Dich!

Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts in various topics and responses to guide AI learning, ensuring the models reflect a comprehensive understanding of diverse subjects.

Highly detail-oriented, able to spot subtle logical/technical issues and explain corrections clearly.

A0WOJ000005N02QIAQ

Sie definieren Schnittstellen, koordinieren Sie die technischen Umsetzungsteams und stellen Sie die Einhaltung von Architekturprinzipien, Qualitätsstandards und Best Practices sicher.
Sie stimmen sich eng mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern ab. Betreuen Sie die Lösung über den gesamten Lebenszyklus – von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur Umsetzung und Inbetriebnahme.
Übernehmen Sie die technische Projektverantwortung. Unterstützen Sie Architekturprüfungen und stellen Sie eine nachhaltige Dokumentation und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Lösung sicher.
Sie sind die Hauptansprechpartner für die Integration der Lösung in bestehende Systeme. Unterstützen Sie die Teams bei Qualifikation, Tests und Support – remote oder vor Ort.

Anforderungen

Studium der Elektrotechnik, Informatik oder vergleichbar an Hochschule oder Fachhochschule.
Kenntnisse in .NET, C++, Java, C#, COM/COM+, XML und idealerweise Ruby sowie den entsprechenden Frameworks.
Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PLM-Systemen wie Siemens Teamcenter oder Oracle Agile.
Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit ECAD-Systemen wie Altium Designer, Siemens PADS, Cadence OrCAD, Autodesk AutoCAD Electrical, EPLAN Electric oder vergleichbaren Tools.
Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit starkem Kundenfokus.
Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch (fließend).

Als Integration Solution Architect für ECAD- und PLM-Systeme gestalten Sie Integrationslösungen und koordinieren deren technische Umsetzung. As a Coding Specialist and AI Trainer, you’ll use your software engineering expertise and Dutch fluency to help improve the capabilities of advanced AI systems.

You’ll evaluate how models reason through complex programming challenges across algorithms, architecture, development, infrastructure, and systems programming.

The role combines hands-on technical assessment with linguistic evaluation, requiring you to communicate naturally and precisely in Dutch.

You’ll challenge models with realistic software engineering scenarios, identify weaknesses, and document reproducible failures to improve future model performance.

Your feedback will help strengthen AI reasoning, coding accuracy, technical communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

The position offers flexible remote contract work for technically skilled professionals who enjoy analyzing complex problems and clearly explaining their reasoning.

Your contributions will help shape AI systems designed to support software development, education, research, and other knowledge-intensive applications.

Accountabilities

Engage with advanced AI models on software engineering tasks, technical scenarios, and coding challenges in Dutch.
Evaluate model responses for logical accuracy, technical correctness, coding quality, and adherence to software engineering best practices.
Assess AI performance across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend and backend development, cloud infrastructure, and systems programming.
Challenge models with technical topics including asynchronous programming, RESTful API integration, memory management, object-oriented design, secure coding, and distributed systems debugging.
Verify the naturalness, fluency, and correctness of Dutch language usage in technical interactions.
Identify and document model failure modes, errors, and reproducible technical issues with sufficient detail for further analysis.
Provide clear, structured feedback and suggestions to improve model reasoning, coding performance, prompt design, and evaluation methodologies.
Explain technical reasoning clearly and demonstrate your analytical process when evaluating model-generated solutions.
Contribute domain expertise that helps improve AI systems intended to support software development, research, education, and other technical applications.

Requirements

Strong professional coding or software engineering expertise, with experience across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend or backend development, cloud infrastructure, or systems programming.
Fluent Dutch language skills, with the ability to communicate naturally and accurately about complex technical subjects.
Strong understanding of software engineering concepts and the ability to critically evaluate technical solutions and code.
Experience with topics such as asynchronous programming, REST APIs, memory management, object-oriented programming, secure coding, or distributed systems is highly relevant.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to technical detail.
Ability to clearly explain technical reasoning and document findings in a structured, reproducible manner.
Strong technical writing skills in Dutch are an advantage.
Bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline is preferred.
Real-world software development experience or open-source contributions is a plus.
Strong metacognitive communication skills, including the ability to explain not only what solution is correct but why.
Ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment and consistently deliver high-quality evaluations.
Comfortable working as an independent contractor and providing your own secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

Flexible remote contract work.

jobs.title: Senior System Architect (all genders welcome) - Upstream Optimization
jobs.description:
To strengthen our development team in Wietmarschen-Lohne we are looking for a

Senior System Architect (all genders welcome) - Upstream Optimization

Upstream Optimization is an innovative business unit of the Rosenxt Group, spun off in 2023 to drive expansion into new business areas. We focus on developing advanced technologies to optimize energy production. Our state-of-the-art flow sensor is a non-intrusive clamp-on system that collects extensive real-time operational process data. To analyze this data, we develop cloud-based software solutions that combine classic signal processing algorithms with artificial intelligence (AI). In our interdisciplinary, agile, and autonomous teams, we drive innovation and customer value forward.

What You Can Expect

Design and own the system architecture for our EMAT flow sensor, with a focus on hardware, software, and AI/signal processing
Develop a coherent overall solution aligned with holistic product requirements
Guide development teams based on the end-to-end system architecture (hardware, software, and cloud application)
Work closely with the Product Owner to embed technical requirements into the system architecture
Act as the technical point of contact for customers and internal stakeholders, presenting architecture decisions and results
Help define product and service requirements together with customer-facing teams and derive appropriate action plans
Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and standards
Derive specifications for system components
Integrate and test the overall system
Help shape agile collaboration and communication across all teams involved

What You Bring

To become part of the Rosenxt family,
you have an analytical, structured and solution-oriented way of working. You should also bring:

Extensive experience in system architecture design
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Embedded Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field
At least 10 years of experience developing complex sensor systems, measurement technology, or embedded systems, ideally in an industrial environment
Knowledge of data science, machine learning, and data analysis tools
Familiarity with relevant European and international standards and directives (EMC, LVD, RED, CRA, ATEX, and ideally IEC 61508 / functional safety) is a plus
Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to tackling project challenges
Excellent written and spoken communication skills in both German and English
Experience working with distributed, cross-functional teams across international locations
Experience in technical project ownership or system/software architecture
Experience in embedded software development (C/C++, RTOS, Embedded Linux) and in designing software architectures for electronics platforms
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, as well as on-premise solutions
Project management knowledge is a plus

Look forward to

Development opportunities and career opportunities in a global, innovative and long-term oriented group of companies with family character
Flexible working time and Home Office possible
An open, informal corporate culture, where we celebrate success with social events

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Coding Specialist (Fluent in Dutch) - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Poland.

As a Coding Specialist and AI Trainer, you’ll use your software engineering expertise and Dutch fluency to help improve the capabilities of advanced AI systems.

You’ll evaluate how models reason through complex programming challenges across algorithms, architecture, development, infrastructure, and systems programming.

The role combines hands-on technical assessment with linguistic evaluation, requiring you to communicate naturally and precisely in Dutch.

You’ll challenge models with realistic software engineering scenarios, identify weaknesses, and document reproducible failures to improve future model performance.

Your feedback will help strengthen AI reasoning, coding accuracy, technical communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

The position offers flexible remote contract work for technically skilled professionals who enjoy analyzing complex problems and clearly explaining their reasoning.

Your contributions will help shape AI systems designed to support software development, education, research, and other knowledge-intensive applications.

Accountabilities

Engage with advanced AI models on software engineering tasks, technical scenarios, and coding challenges in Dutch.
Evaluate model responses for logical accuracy, technical correctness, coding quality, and adherence to software engineering best practices.
Assess AI performance across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend and backend development, cloud infrastructure, and systems programming.
Challenge models with technical topics including asynchronous programming, RESTful API integration, memory management, object-oriented design, secure coding, and distributed systems debugging.
Verify the naturalness, fluency, and correctness of Dutch language usage in technical interactions.
Identify and document model failure modes, errors, and reproducible technical issues with sufficient detail for further analysis.
Provide clear, structured feedback and suggestions to improve model reasoning, coding performance, prompt design, and evaluation methodologies.
Explain technical reasoning clearly and demonstrate your analytical process when evaluating model-generated solutions.
Contribute domain expertise that helps improve AI systems intended to support software development, research, education, and other technical applications.

Requirements

Strong professional coding or software engineering expertise, with experience across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend or backend development, cloud infrastructure, or systems programming.
Fluent Dutch language skills, with the ability to communicate naturally and accurately about complex technical subjects.
Strong understanding of software engineering concepts and the ability to critically evaluate technical solutions and code.
Experience with topics such as asynchronous programming, REST APIs, memory management, object-oriented programming, secure coding, or distributed systems is highly relevant.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to technical detail.
Ability to clearly explain technical reasoning and document findings in a structured, reproducible manner.
Strong technical writing skills in Dutch are an advantage.
Bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline is preferred.
Real-world software development experience or open-source contributions is a plus.
Strong metacognitive communication skills, including the ability to explain not only what solution is correct but why.
Ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment and consistently deliver high-quality evaluations.
Comfortable working as an independent contractor and providing your own secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

Benefits

Pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined based on experience, expertise, and geographic location.
Flexible remote contract work.
Opportunity to contribute directly to the development and improvement of advanced AI systems.
Exposure to challenging software engineering problems across a broad range of technical domains.
Opportunity to apply both coding expertise and Dutch language skills in an AI training environment.
Flexible freelance engagement without a fixed employee schedule.
Contractor arrangement with the ability to work remotely from an eligible location.
Contractors are responsible for providing their own secure computer and high-speed internet.

jobs.description:
Cloud architect - Azure løsninger

Er du cloud architect og har du evnen og interessen for at prøve kræfter med udvikling af komplekse Azure cloud løsninger? cVation søger cloud architects, som kan designe Azure løsninger på PaaS og container services. cVation er et dansk udviklings- og konsulenthus, som bygger avancerede cloud-løsninger på Azure med afsæt i markedets hurtigste og mest agile metoder. cVation blev stiftet i 2014, har modtaget tre Børsen Gazeller og vundet Microsofts Partner Award for App Innovation tre år i træk. Vi arbejder dedikeret med agile arbejdsmetoder, DevOps og Test Driven Development, og er på forkant med mange af de nye teknologier, herunder IoT. Vi sætter desuden en ære i at levere software af den højeste kvalitet.

Hvilken rolle får du?

Du vil blive cloud architect på et af vores teams, der designer og udvikler avancerede cloud løsninger i Azure. Vi er dedikerede til agile arbejdsmetoder, DevOps og Test Driven Development (TDD). Vi har en meget høj release-frekvens i vores projekter, da brugen af vores egenudviklede tool CADD resulterer i ekstremt agile IT-projekter.

Som cloud architect kan du have din primære styrke enten inden for applikationsudvikling eller infrastruktur – eller begge dele. Uanset din profil bliver du den tekniske ekspert, der forstår kundens forretningsbehov og kan konvertere det til et teknisk design, som sikrer, at projektet bliver en sikker, skalerbar og pålidelig Azure løsning. Vi anvender Microsofts Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) og Azure Landing Zones som fundament for vores tilgang til cloud-arkitektur. Du sikrer desuden, at løsningen bygges efter DevOps principper med infrastructure as code. Ud over dit daglige arbejde som cloud architect på et af vores udviklingsteams, vil du løbende rådgive andre teams i de Azure services, som du er ekspert i – hvad enten det er inden for netværk, sikkerhed, containerplatforme, PaaS eller noget helt andet. Herudover deltager du også som teknisk rådgiver i indledende analyser og kundemøder. Ud over at designe og kommunikere de store linjer på arkitekturen, har du også lyst til at være hands on, når de sværeste komponenter skal bygges.

Udviklerne i cVation er typisk samlet i teams på 5-8 udviklere. Derudover har vi også etableret et CCoE (Cloud Center of Excellence), som løbende vurderer nye cloud services og opdaterer værktøjskassen med relevante opdateringer. CCoE arbejder tæt sammen med de enkelte udviklingsteams, som har fingeren på pulsen ude på kundeprojekterne.

Hvad forventer vi af dig?

Du har flere års erfaring med arkitekturdesign og vil gerne arbejde med de nyeste teknologier i Azure
Du har erfaring med Azure PaaS, IaaS og/eller container services
Du vil gerne rådgive kunden i fordele og ulemper omkring en række Azure services og teknologier indenfor infrastruktur, funktionalitet, sikkerhed, skalering og oppetid
Du har erfaring med Azure DevOps (el. lignende), automatiserede pipelines og du praktiserer infrastructure as code
Du kan indgå i en professionel dialog med både kundens forretning, arkitekter og udviklere
Du kan drive tekniske kundemøder og det samlede arkitekturspor på et projekt
Du kan reviewe og validere eksisterende arkitekturdesign
Du er i stand til at løfte det tekniske niveau på et team og øge kvaliteten af en leverance
Du vil gerne indgå i et agilt setup, hvor krav og retning hurtigt kan ændres, men hvor medbestemmelse og frihed er i højsædet
Du har en kandidat i softwareudvikling
Du taler og skriver både dansk og engelsk på højt niveau

Som person tager du ansvar, er initiativrig og eksekverende. Du gør dig umage med dine opgaver og trives med at løfte i flok som del af et team. Hvis du også er engageret, nysgerrig, drevet af at lære nyt og sætter en ære i at dygtiggøre dig, passer du perfekt ind hos os. Du må også gerne gå op i at forbedre både kode, værktøjer samt processer.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du kommer til at indgå i vores voksende team, hvor høj faglighed, innovation og arbejdsglæde er i højsæde. Det høje faglige niveau blandt dine kollegaer giver en unik mulighed for at arbejde med de bedste, og vi tager din faglige udvikling alvorligt. Vi har en flad organisation med et minimum af administration, hvor ledelsens døre altid er åbne, og der er god plads til både bordfodbold, fredagsbar, frokost på kajen og et aktivt liv udenfor arbejdstid. Flere gange om året afholder vi hackathons, hvor vi i teams dykker ned i præcis de emner, som udviklerne finder interessante. En del af vores kultur er også, at vi gerne ser alle komme med input til hvordan vi kan optimere, udvikle og forbedre cVation.

Hvorfor vælge os som din nye arbejdsplads?

Vores fundament er løsninger bygget på Microsoft Azure Cloud. Alle vores medarbejdere mestrer cloud-native udvikling og DevOps. Vi arbejder i projekter og engagerer os hands-on i fælles teams med vores kunder for at sikre kvalitet og effektiv videndeling.

Vi er passionerede omkring at hjælpe vores kunder med at få det maksimale ud af cloudteknologien. For os er cloud ikke blot infrastruktur eller et nyt datacenter i skyen. Teknologien giver virksomheder mulighed for at skabe væsentligt mere værdi og arbejde med agilitet og innovation på en helt ny måde.

Job Description: Azure Cloud Engineer (DevOps/Terraform)

Location: Singapore

Employment Type: Fixed-Term Contract (1 Year)

About Us

Dymon Asia Capital (“Dymon Asia”), founded in 2008, is a leading alternative investment firm with assets across public and private markets. The firm’s flagship hedge fund product is the Multi-Strategy Investment Fund (MSIF), an Asia-focused multi-manager multi-strategy fund that seeks to generate absolute consistent uncorrelated returns from emerging and developed markets.

Headquartered in Singapore, Dymon Asia operates from nine offices across the Middle East and Asia, including Hong Kong, Tokyo, Dubai, Shanghai, Mumbai, and Kuala Lumpur. Our platform is built on our people. We bring together diverse perspectives, expertise, and experience across our multi-strategy and private markets businesses. Maintaining a collaborative culture where our people are set up to do their best work is central to how we operate.

Core Engineering is looking for an Azure Cloud Engineer to join the Azure Cloud Team, responsible for designing, building, and operating the CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) layer that underpins our Azure cloud platform. This role is suited to an engineer who wants meaningful ownership of the Terraform and GitLab toolchain for management groups, subscriptions, networks, shared services, and application landing zones, and who will help embed DevSecOps practices into every pipeline. This is a 1-year fixed-term contract position.

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement Terraform modules for Azure, covering management groups, subscriptions, RBAC, hub-and-spoke VNets, firewalls, private endpoints, and shared services such as Key Vault, Log Analytics/Grafana, storage, container apps, and data platform components.
Manage remote state, workspaces, and module versioning, and promote changes safely across dev, QA, and production environments.
Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines for infrastructure, with fmt, validate, plan, and apply stages (non-prod and gated prod) and MR-driven workflows featuring terraform plan comments, approvals, and controlled apply.
Create reusable CI templates so application and data teams can easily consume standard jobs for infrastructure, deployment, and smoke tests.
Work with application and data teams to integrate their repositories with GitLab CI templates (build, test, deploy) and wire deployments into Azure landing zones (App Service, Container Apps, Functions, Databricks, etc.), using Dev/QA/UAT/Prod environment patterns aligned to the new subscription and VNet structure.
Integrate security scanning tools into CI pipelines (e.g. JFrog Advanced Security, SAST/SCA/IaC scanners) and help define policies and thresholds for blocking promotions based on vulnerability severity.
Collaborate with Security and Infrastructure teams to ensure pipelines enforce guardrails by default, such as policy checks and image/IaC scans.
Integrate pipelines with monitoring and alerting (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana) for infrastructure and applications, and contribute to cost optimisation through auto-shutdown patterns for non-prod and standardized scaling and sizing parameters in Terraform modules.
Participate in incident response and post-mortems, improving pipeline resilience and roll-back strategies.
Document CI/CD patterns, Terraform module usage, and how-to guides, coach engineers on using GitLab pipelines, writing safe Terraform changes, and reading plan outputs, and promote an infra-as-code only mindset with no manual portal changes for platform resources.

Job Requirements

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline preferred.
5 to 8 years of experience in DevOps or Platform Engineering, with significant time on Azure.
Strong hands-on experience with Terraform on Azure, including modules, multi-environment setups, and state backends.
Proven track record building CI/CD pipelines in GitLab (or similar) for both infrastructure and applications.
Solid understanding of Azure networking, including VNets, NSGs, private endpoints, and VPN/ExpressRoute.
Working knowledge of Azure identity and platform services, including RBAC, managed identities, Key Vault, and Log Analytics.
Competent in at least one scripting language (e.g. Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and glue code.
Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, including integrating SAST, SCA/OSS, secret scanning, and container/IaC scanning into pipelines.
Comfortable reviewing and improving others' Terraform and CI configurations via merge requests, with strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, pipelines, and cloud services.
Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to work effectively with infrastructure, security, and application teams.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to technical detail.
Ability to clearly explain technical reasoning and document findings in a structured, reproducible manner.
Strong technical writing skills in Dutch are an advantage.
Bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline is preferred.

Strong metacognitive communication skills, including the ability to explain not only what solution is correct but why.

Comfortable working as an independent contractor and providing your own secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

jobs.title: IAM Engineer
jobs.description:
IT-Planet is dé HR specialist voor flexibele en tijdelijke staffing in IT. Wij verzorgen IT-projecten bij diverse top 100-klanten over heel Vlaanderen en Brussel in volgende IT-domeinen: Application Development, Infrastructure Services & Software Testing. Met 20 jaar ervaring achter de kiezen kunnen wij perfect tegemoet komen aan jouw individuele noden. Bij ons kan en mag je groeien en leren, kortom floreren in jouw job. Sounds good? Op vandaag hebben wij reeds 180 fijne collega’s op project. Om ons team verder te versterken zijn we momenteel op zoek naar een IAM Engineer
(m/v/x) om aan de slag te gaan bij onze klant in Antwerpen
.

Deze positie kan worden ingevuld met zowel vast contract (bediendestatuut) als freelance contract
Duurtijd: Lange termijn

Regio: Antwerpen

Fulltime

We zijn op zoek naar een IAM Engineer met sterke .NET- en Azure-ervaring om het team te versterken dat verantwoordelijk is voor de backend van ons interne identity orchestration platform. De kandidaat moet aantoonbare IAM-expertise hebben en in staat zijn om richting te geven aan de implementatie van identity governance, provisioning en fijnmazige autorisatieoplossingen.
In deze rol onderhoud en ontwikkel je bestaande .NET-componenten verder en werk je mee aan de overgang naar een moderne, cloud-native architectuur op Azure. Je draagt bij aan IAM-gerelateerde evoluties, API-beveiliging en nieuwe Azure-gebaseerde modules.

Taken:

Je ondersteunt en ontwikkelt het interne identity orchestration platform verder en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor de bijbehorende analyse, ontwikkeling, onderhoud en opvolging
Je helpt bestaande .NET-componenten te migreren naar een cloud-native doelarchitectuur op Azure. Je begrijpt de huidige stack, identificeert herbruikbare componenten en vertaalt functionele behoeften naar onderhoudbare, cloud-ready oplossingen
Je ontwerpt en bouwt nieuwe Azure-gebaseerde IAM-functionaliteiten vanaf nul, met componenten zoals Azure Functions, Azure Container Apps en Azure Key Vault, en integreert deze met REST-services en identity providers
Je ondersteunt IAM-gerelateerde ontwikkeling rond onder andere user provisioning, API security, tokenconversie met gebruikerscontext en wijzigingen binnen identity governance (IGA)
Je volgt IAM-gerelateerde incidenten op en ondersteunt vulnerability management voor de componenten waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent
Je past je expertise in IAM en security engineering toe om veilig gebruikersbeheer, toegangscontrole en API-integraties te ondersteunen
Je levert input op senior niveau rond IAM-architectuur en ondersteunt de implementatie van de afgesproken architectuur, inclusief het gedetailleerde ontwerp en de oplevering van IAM-oplossingen zoals policy-based authorization
Je ontwerpt en implementeert identity lifecycle management en user provisioning-oplossingen, inclusief integraties met identity providers en SCIM-gebaseerde flows
Je ontwerpt en implementeert fijnmazige autorisatie met behulp van policy engines en standaarden zoals OPA, OpenFGA of AuthZen. Je past geschikte autorisatiemodellen toe, waaronder RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC en PBAC
Je onderhoudt en implementeert oplossingen binnen de afgesproken timing en kwaliteitsnormen
Je documenteert implementaties en wijzigingen
Je ondersteunt analisten en designers bij het vertalen van functionele specificaties naar technische oplossingen
Je levert 3rd-line support
Je volgt technische evoluties op en kunt zelfstandig onderzoek uitvoeren, met ondersteuning van een application architect
Je begrijpt de technische architectuur en hergebruikt bestaande technische componenten
Je helpt bij geplande productie-deployments buiten de kantooruren

Skills:

Brede IT-kennis en interesse in verschillende IT-domeinen
Sterke planningsvaardigheden; je durft de AS-IS in vraag te stellen en bent resultaatgericht
Je voelt je comfortabel bij het werken met verspreide, internationale teams
Je kunt zelfstandig werken binnen een complexe applicatielandschap en zorgt voor continuïteit bij terugkerende wijzigingen
Ervaring met Identity & Access Management, waaronder identity governance and administration, identity lifecycle management en user provisioning
Ervaring met .NET back-end / back-office development
Hands-on ervaring met identity providers zoals Keycloak, Duende IdentityServer of Microsoft Entra ID
Hands-on ervaring met SCIM, OIDC en OAuth 2.1 voor provisioning-, authenticatie- en autorisatie-integraties
Ervaring met fijnmazige autorisatie, waaronder OPA, OpenFGA of AuthZen, en met autorisatiemodellen zoals RBAC, ABAC, ReBAC of PBAC
Ervaring met SQL
REST API’s – ontwerpen, bouwen en gebruiken van RESTful services (JSON)
Ervaring met CI/CD-pipelines in Azure DevOps voor het deployen van oplossingen over verschillende omgevingen
Secure cloud development practices, waaronder het gebruik van Azure Key Vault voor gevoelige informatie
Source control met Git
Ervaring met Agile en een DevOps-cultuur
Ervaring met IAM-gerelateerde ontwikkeling of onderhoud binnen een beveiligde klant- of partnerportaalomgeving

Wat er bijkomt

Je wordt verloond naar takenpakket, kennis en competenties. Met zorg werken wij een motiverend salarispakket uit inclusief een interessant extralegaal pakket met een groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een jaarlijks budget voor de aankoop van persoonlijk IT-materiaal, … Tevens bieden we je graag een bedrijfswagen met laad- of tankkaart aan.

Wat echt telt

Jij en jouw persoonlijke wensen en noden staan voor ons centraal. Aan de hand van persoonlijke opvolging en contacten streven we samen naar jouw gewenste carrière. We bieden je de doorgroeimogelijkheden en uitdagingen die je ambieert, en begeleiden je aan de hand van een professioneel opleidings- en evolutiebeleid. Work-life balance vinden we belangrijk, in dit kader bieden wij ook graag flexibiliteit. Daarnaast organiseren we jaarlijks tal van superfijne evenementen waar we jou steeds voor uitnodigen! Zo zijn we ook elk jaar als sponsor aanwezig op enkele festivals.

Al het bovenstaande, en veel meer, zorgt ervoor dat wij jaar na jaar de award voor Great Place to Work binnenhalen!

Freelance? Aarzel zeker niet om ons te contacteren voor een voorstel op maat. En ja, ook als freelancer kan je genieten van opleidingen en evenementen via IT-Planet!

Sopra Steria offers tailored, end-to-end corporate technology and software solutions to help clients make bold choices and deliver results. Successfully so! With more than 51.000 colleagues in nearly 30 countries, we rank

as Europe’s leading digital solutions provider. Some of the most successful companies in Europe rely on our technology due to our commitment to innovation, collaboration, and value in business development.

The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together.

Are you a solution architect? Or do you want to start in a position within solution selling? Then the vacancy below is definitely for you!

As a Cloud Solution Architect, you will help define how we get there! In this role you will focus on architecture and solution selling mainly within Azure. We are looking for someone who is passionate about cloud native solutions and digital transformation. We would love to give you the opportunity to fully unleash your passion at our customers. We will help you grow personally and leverage your technical knowledge to become a trusted partner for IT and Business.

You understand the business and can translate it into IT, requirement gathering is your hobby and the R's of application modernization are not unknown to you. Creating roadmaps and building a solution portfolio is somehting you do for breakfast. Guiding and inspiring teams is your dessert after lunch. Cloud Adoption Framework, Well Architected, SaaS, PaaS etc. sound familiar? Then you are the right person.

Qualifications

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

You’ll have knowledge and experience of the following:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or a relevant equivalent
Extensive experience in Designing, implementing and supporting cloud projects
Brown- and greenfield approaches
Azure cloud technologies
Analysis of complex problems and tackling them with a commercial mindset
Digital innovation and transformation
Business mindset and creating new opportunity
(Pre)Sales
You are a trusted advisor, and you will lead your client to new insights
You breathe digital innovation and transformation and are able to see the bigger picture

Become part of a major Tech player in Europe that is recognised for consulting, digital services and software development. Work among high-level professionals who dare to make bold choices to deliver results.

Additionally, you’ll join the Business Line DPS (Digital Platform Services). DPS operates in the industrial, life sciences, public and finance sectors and is focused on core IT, from the front-end to the backend of business platforms. With our services, we ensure the continuity of processes and optimize customers' IT strategy, so they benefit from technological capabilities, control their costs and make platforms current and profitable.

This is what you’ll get from us

Doing what you love? It’s not just a myth at Sopra Steria. Start your way to excellence with the Sopra Steria Academy. Here, experts and coaches push you to be the best version of yourself. That’s why we offer a flexible working arrangement (with both local and international opportunities) so you can work in an environment that inspires you. Even if that’s in your backyard.

We offer a generous employee benefits package that includes:

A company car or mobility budget
Laptop, phone & phone subscription
A competitive salary and indefinite contract
Insurance coverage, meal vouchers, eco-cheques, and more
Continuous learning opportunities through the Sopra Steria Academy to support your career development

Ready to take the next step?

We’re here to support you all the way and we are looking forward to your application!

jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Coding Specialist (Fluent in Dutch) - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland.

As a Coding Specialist and AI Trainer, you’ll use your software engineering expertise and Dutch fluency to help improve the capabilities of advanced AI systems.

You’ll evaluate how models reason through complex programming challenges across algorithms, architecture, development, infrastructure, and systems programming.

The role combines hands-on technical assessment with linguistic evaluation, requiring you to communicate naturally and precisely in Dutch.

You’ll challenge models with realistic software engineering scenarios, identify weaknesses, and document reproducible failures to improve future model performance.

Your feedback will help strengthen AI reasoning, coding accuracy, technical communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

The position offers flexible remote contract work for technically skilled professionals who enjoy analyzing complex problems and clearly explaining their reasoning.

Your contributions will help shape AI systems designed to support software development, education, research, and other knowledge-intensive applications.

Accountabilities

Engage with advanced AI models on software engineering tasks, technical scenarios, and coding challenges in Dutch.
Evaluate model responses for logical accuracy, technical correctness, coding quality, and adherence to software engineering best practices.
Assess AI performance across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend and backend development, cloud infrastructure, and systems programming.
Challenge models with technical topics including asynchronous programming, RESTful API integration, memory management, object-oriented design, secure coding, and distributed systems debugging.
Verify the naturalness, fluency, and correctness of Dutch language usage in technical interactions.
Identify and document model failure modes, errors, and reproducible technical issues with sufficient detail for further analysis.
Provide clear, structured feedback and suggestions to improve model reasoning, coding performance, prompt design, and evaluation methodologies.
Explain technical reasoning clearly and demonstrate your analytical process when evaluating model-generated solutions.
Contribute domain expertise that helps improve AI systems intended to support software development, research, education, and other technical applications.

Requirements

Strong professional coding or software engineering expertise, with experience across areas such as algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend or backend development, cloud infrastructure, or systems programming.
Fluent Dutch language skills, with the ability to communicate naturally and accurately about complex technical subjects.
Strong understanding of software engineering concepts and the ability to critically evaluate technical solutions and code.
Experience with topics such as asynchronous programming, REST APIs, memory management, object-oriented programming, secure coding, or distributed systems is highly relevant.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to technical detail.
Ability to clearly explain technical reasoning and document findings in a structured, reproducible manner.
Strong technical writing skills in Dutch are an advantage.
Bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline is preferred.
Real-world software development experience or open-source contributions is a plus.
Strong metacognitive communication skills, including the ability to explain not only what solution is correct but why.
Ability to work independently in a remote, project-based environment and consistently deliver high-quality evaluations.
Comfortable working as an independent contractor and providing your own secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

Benefits

Pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined based on experience, expertise, and geographic location.
Flexible remote contract work.
Opportunity to contribute directly to the development and improvement of advanced AI systems.
Exposure to challenging software engineering problems across a broad range of technical domains.
Opportunity to apply both coding expertise and Dutch language skills in an AI training environment.
Flexible freelance engagement without a fixed employee schedule.

jobs.title: Data & AI Architect – Life Sciences
jobs.description:
About the role

We are looking for a Manager / Senior Data & AI Architect to join our Barcelona team and help us grow one of BIP Iberia’s strategic areas: the application of Data, Analytics and Artificial Intelligence within Life Sciences.

This is not a pure architecture role. We are looking for someone who combines strong technical depth with business understanding, client-facing skills and a pre-sales/commercial mindset. Someone who can design a robust architecture, defend it with a client, understand the business problem behind it and guide the team until the solution is successfully delivered and operational.

The role will be part of BIP's Global Data & AI team, with a strong focus on working closely with our local teams in Barcelona and across Spain, while collaborating with colleagues and specialists across Portugal, Italy and other BIP geographies.

Your mission

Act as a Data & AI reference for Life Sciences, connecting strategy, business and technology. You will be involved from early client conversations and pre-sales through architecture definition, delivery and the evolution of production solutions.

You will also help build capabilities, reusable assets, propositions and references that strengthen our position in the Life Sciences market.

What you will do

Design end-to-end Data, Analytics and AI architectures covering data platforms, lakehouse, integration, governance, advanced analytics, Machine Learning, GenAI and AI agents.

Translate Life Sciences business needs into concrete, scalable, secure and measurable technology solutions.

Act as a trusted technical advisor for CIOs, CDOs, Data & AI leaders, business stakeholders and architecture teams.

Play an active role in pre-sales: discovery, workshops, RFP/RFI responses, estimates, proposals, roadmaps, high-level architectures, demos, PoCs and executive presentations.

Work jointly with commercial leaders and Partners to identify and mature opportunities, bringing technical credibility and sector knowledge.

Provide technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams including Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, ML Engineers and AI specialists.

Define architecture standards and patterns across security, integration, observability, MLOps/LLMOps, governance and data quality.

Support solutions through production, ensuring operability, performance, security, cost control and long-term scalability.

Contribute to the growth of the Data & AI practice in Barcelona and to BIP’s international Life Sciences collaboration.

Mentor junior colleagues and raise the technical bar through design reviews, best practices and knowledge sharing.

Industry knowledge – Life Sciences

Relevant experience or strong knowledge of the Life Sciences sector is important. The successful candidate should understand key business processes, industry challenges and the regulatory context in which clients operate.

Experience in Pharma, Biotech, MedTech, Healthcare or related environments.

Understanding of Data & AI use cases across R&D, clinical, medical affairs, commercial, market access, supply chain, manufacturing, quality or patient/healthcare analytics.

Ability to work with sensitive data and regulated environments, with awareness of privacy, traceability, quality, governance and compliance principles.

Knowledge of scientific, clinical, commercial or healthcare data ecosystems will be highly valued.

Essential requirements

Strong experience, ideally 7+ years, across Data, Analytics, Cloud or AI, with increasing responsibility in architecture and/or technical leadership.

Proven experience or strong domain knowledge in Life Sciences, with an understanding of the sector's key business processes, data ecosystems, and regulatory context.

Proven experience designing modern data solutions: data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse, streaming, APIs and integration, batch and real-time processing, modelling and governance.

Deep knowledge of at least one major hyperscaler (Azure, AWS or Google Cloud) and the ability to operate in multi-cloud environments.

Experience with modern data platforms such as Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery or equivalent technologies.

Strong SQL skills and solid Python knowledge; practical understanding of Spark and distributed architectures.

Knowledge of AI/ML and GenAI architectures, including LLMs, RAG, agents, vector search, evaluation, guardrails, observability and industrialisation patterns.

Strong client-facing experience and the ability to communicate complex decisions to both technical and executive audiences.

Hands-on experience in technical pre-sales and in preparing and defending proposals.

Professional English at a minimum C1 level. Professional Spanish. Italian or Portuguese is a plus.

Availability to work in a hybrid model based in Barcelona and to travel occasionally depending on client/project needs.

Nice to have

Previous experience in technology or strategy consulting.

Commercial or business development experience within Data & AI.

Relevant certifications across Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Databricks, Snowflake or other leading platforms.

Experience in Data Governance, Data Mesh, catalogues, MDM, data quality and data-product-oriented architectures.

Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, CI/CD, DevOps and platform automation.

Knowledge of FinOps and performance/cost optimisation.

Ability to build accelerators, assets and reusable solutions.

International experience, with a track record of working with stakeholders across different geographies and multicultural environments.

Personal capabilities

Consulting mindset and client orientation: listen, structure ambiguous problems and turn them into actionable decisions.

Technical credibility: ability to go deep when required while maintaining an end-to-end perspective.

Business orientation: understanding that architecture is a means to create impact, not an end in itself.

Communication and influencing skills: confidently present and defend proposals to technical teams, business stakeholders and senior management.

Commercial and pre-sales mindset: comfortable participating in opportunity discussions and shaping a compelling value proposition.

Leadership without hierarchy: ability to mobilise teams, make decisions and build trust.

Pragmatism, autonomy and end-to-end ownership.

Curiosity and continuous learning in a fast-moving technology environment.

What we offer

A strategic role supporting the growth of Data & AI and Life Sciences within BIP Iberia.

High client ex
posure and direct participation in relevant transformation initiatives.

Real opportunity to influence the development of the practice and new business opportunities.

Collaboration with international teams and specialists across multiple geographies.

Data, Analytics, AI and GenAI projects using leading technologies.

Professional development, training and support for certifications.

Hybrid working model based in Barcelona, with flexibility aligned to project needs.

Competitive compensation aligned with experience and responsibility.

Why BIP?

Growth & Learning

Access to 300+ courses on emerging technologies and business topics, personalized development programs, and continuous training initiatives to support your professional and personal growth.

Flexibility & Work-Life Integration

Hybrid working model with flexibility to balance remote and office work in agreement with your manager and project needs, plus initiatives supporting work-life balance.

Health & Benefits

Private health insurance, wellness platforms, meal vouchers, and an attractive benefits package.

Family & Parenthood

Support for new parents, including enhanced parental leave benefits and dedicated initiatives during and after parental leave.

Inclusion & Values

We promote uniqueness and equal opportunities for everyone. We are committed to creating an ethical, inclusive, and welcoming work environment.

Next Steps

Once we receive your CV, we will carefully review your profile. If there is a match with this or other open positions within the Group, we will contact you to start our mutual introduction process.

The selection process generally includes an HR interview, a technical interview with a Line Manager, and potentially a final interview with a Partner. The number and order of interviews may vary.

About Us

Founded in 2003, BIP combines the historical excellence of management consulting with innovation and digitalization. Today we are more than 6.500 professionals across 13 countries, delivering over 4,500 projects worldwide.

We support our clients in driving large-scale impact through Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IoT, and disruptive technologies across all industries.

We believe in excellence as our guiding principle and adopt an ethical and fair approach toward everyone who chooses to work with us, fostering an environment where people grow together through diverse expertise.

You’ll evaluate how models reason through complex programming challenges across algorithms, architecture, development, infrastructure, and systems programming.

You’ll challenge models with realistic software engineering scenarios, identify weaknesses, and document reproducible failures to improve future model performance.

Your feedback will help strengthen AI reasoning, coding accuracy, technical communication, and problem-solving capabilities.

Experience with topics such as asynchronous programming, REST APIs, memory management, object-oriented programming, secure coding, or distributed systems is highly relevant.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with strong attention to technical detail.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll contribute across both frontend and backend development to build reliable, scalable applications in modern cloud environments.

You’ll work with technologies spanning Java, JavaScript, Python, web frameworks, containerization, and cloud infrastructure.

The role combines hands-on software development with deployment automation, CI/CD, and modern application delivery practices.

You’ll collaborate within an Agile development environment, contributing to technical planning, implementation, testing, and continuous improvement.

Your work will help deliver secure and resilient applications while supporting efficient deployment across complex cloud platforms.

You’ll operate in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where strong problem-solving, communication, and ownership are essential.

This opportunity is well suited to an engineer who enjoys working across the full application stack and adapting to evolving technical challenges.

Accountabilities

Develop and maintain software applications using Java, JavaScript, Python, or related technologies.
Build and enhance frontend applications using modern web technologies including HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript ES6+.
Develop user interfaces with frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.js, including relevant state management solutions such as Redux, NgRx, or Vuex.
Contribute to backend application development and integration using technologies such as Java, Python, C#, and .NET.
Design, deploy, and maintain containerized applications using Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, Containerd, or similar technologies.
Support application deployment across cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, OpenStack, or OpenShift.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated build processes, deployment workflows, and configuration tools.
Participate in Agile development practices and use collaboration and project management tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Collaborate with engineers and other stakeholders to design solutions, troubleshoot technical issues, and deliver project objectives.
Apply strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to address technical challenges and improve application reliability.
Contribute to on-time project delivery through effective planning, prioritization, and time management.
Maintain clear technical communication and documentation throughout the development lifecycle.

Requirements

4-year degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
Professional development experience with at least one of Java, JavaScript, or Python.
Strong knowledge of core web technologies, including HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
Hands-on experience with at least one major frontend framework or library, such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
Familiarity with frontend state management technologies such as Redux, NgRx, or Vuex.
Familiarity with C# and .NET is preferred.
Hands-on experience with application containerization using Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, Containerd, or similar technologies.
Experience deploying containerized applications in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, OpenStack, or OpenShift.
Experience working with CI/CD deployment pipelines, automated builds, and configuration management tools.
Experience working in an Agile software development environment and familiarity with tools such as JIRA and Confluence.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams.
Demonstrated ability to build strong working relationships and consistently deliver high-quality results.
Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.
Strong organizational and time-management skills with a focus on meeting project deadlines.
Familiarity with the space domain is a plus.

Benefits

Remote work opportunity.
Opportunity to work across both frontend and backend software engineering.
Exposure to modern cloud platforms and containerized application environments.
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, CI/CD, and Agile development practices.
Opportunity to work with a broad range of programming languages and modern web technologies.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving hard problems around concurrency, performance, reliability, and production observability.

You’ll join an Agile squad and work closely with product and engineering peers to deliver scalable, secure microservices that perform under heavy load and remain transparent in production through strong telemetry and monitoring.

What you’ll be doing
Build and evolve .NET Core microservices used in real-time trading workflows
Design for high concurrency using async programming and multi-threading, with a strong focus on thread safety
Implement event-driven patterns using Kafka, AWS SQS, RabbitMQ or similar messaging technologies
Optimise services for low-latency and high-throughput workloads
Improve resilience and fault tolerance across distributed components
Contribute to modern architecture approaches including Clean Architecture, Vertical Slice Architecture and CQRS
Translate trading and financial requirements into robust technical solutions
Maintain quality through TDD, code reviews, and strong automated testing (unit, integration, performance)
Implement OpenTelemetry for tracing, metrics and logs
Build and maintain dashboards and alerting using Prometheus, Grafana and Kibana to ensure actionable insight in production
Participate fully in Scrum ceremonies and Agile delivery practices

What eMagine Solutions is looking for
5+ years of software engineering experience with strong C# and .NET Core expertise
Deep experience with multi-threading, async patterns, and concurrency in distributed systems
Proven delivery of domain-driven microservices and strong understanding of service boundaries
Strong knowledge of event-driven systems and messaging frameworks (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ)
Practical experience with observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Elastic/Kibana
CI/CD experience plus containerisation with Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes
Strong Git and version control best practices
Comfortable working in Scrum-based Agile teams

Nice to have
Experience with Saga patterns for distributed transactions
Experience in trading or financial systems, especially low-latency environments
SQL Server performance tuning and database optimisation

Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
Relevant certifications in software development, architecture, or AWS are beneficial

jobs.description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for a talented and versatile Full Stack Developer with expertise in .NET and React to join our development team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing and building modern, scalable web applications from the database layer to the user interface. You will bridge the gap between back-end logic and front-end, ensuring seamless integration and high performance. The ideal candidate is passionate about clean code, enjoys solving complex problems, and stays up-to-date with the latest industry trends.

Job Description:

Full Stack Development

• Design, develop, and maintain robust web applications using .NET Core / .NET 6/8+ for the back-end and React.js for the front-end.
• Build reusable, testable, and efficient code following industry best practices.
• Develop and consume RESTful APIs and integrate them with the React front-end.
• Implement responsive and intuitive user interfaces based on UI/UX designs.

Back-End (.NET)

• Write clean C# code following Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles and design patterns.
• Develop server-side logic, API endpoints, and middleware.
• Perform database design, development, and optimization using SQL Server (writing queries, stored procedures, and Entity Framework Core).

Front-End (React)

• Build dynamic single-page applications (SPAs) using React.js with Hooks and Context API or Redux.
• Translate designs and wireframes into high-quality, responsive components.
• Ensure cross-browser compatibility and optimize front-end performance.

Skills and Qualifications:

Technical Skills (Back-End)

• Languages: C#, .NET Core / ASP.NET Core.
• Frameworks: Entity Framework / Entity Framework Core, LINQ.
• Database: Strong proficiency in SQL Server (database design, query optimization).
• APIs: Building and documenting RESTful APIs (Swagger/OpenAPI).

Technical Skills (Front-End)

• Core: Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3.
• Framework: Extensive experience with React.js (Hooks, Context API, Lifecycle methods).
• State Management: Experience with state management libraries like Redux or Zustand.
• Styling: Familiarity with CSS frameworks (Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS) or pre-processors (SASS).

General Technical Skills

• Version control using Git (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps).
• Understanding of authentication and authorization mechanisms (JWT, OAuth, IdentityServer).
• Basic knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure / AWS) is a plus.
